name: Notary Public Mall

example.zh: 例如生命或居住證明書。

example.zh: 例如進入加拿大的旅行申請。

example.en: Such as declarations of identity, marital status, or progress payment.
example.zh: 例如身份、婚姻狀況或進度付款的聲明。

Such as a consent letter for children traveling and letters of invitation.

text.en: We can come to your home, office, or a location of your choice.
text.zh: 我們可以上門到您的住所、辦公室或指定地點。

text.en: Same-day appointments available for urgent requests.
text.zh: 緊急情況可安排即日預約。

text.en: Your documents are handled with the utmost privacy and security.
text.zh: 您的文件會以最嚴格的私隱和安全標準處理。

text.en: Transparent fees with no hidden costs.
text.zh: 收費透明，沒有隱藏費用。

text.en: Book online or contact us directly to arrange a convenient time.
text.zh: 網上預約或直接聯絡我們，安排合適的時間。

intro.en: At Notary Public Mall, we provide a wide range of reliable and professional mobile notary services across Ontario.
intro.zh: 我們在全安大略省範圍內提供可靠且專業的流動公證服務。

intro.en: Our mission is to offer convenient and affordable notary services for individuals and businesses, ensuring that your documents are properly notarized with the highest level of care and attention to detail.
intro.zh: 我們的使命是為個人及企業提供便捷及價格具競爭力的公證服務，確保您的文件經過適當公證，並以最高的專業水準和細心處理每一個細節。

text.en: We proudly serve the North York, Scarborough, Markham, and Richmond Hill areas of Ontario.
text.zh: 安省北約克，士嘉堡，萬錦及列治文山等地區

paragraphs.en: We understand that certain individuals face financial challenges, particularly those who have immigrated to Canada due to the Russia-Ukraine war or the Hong Kong National Security Law.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你是由於俄烏戰爭或香港國安法移民到加拿大而又有經濟困難的，這個公證服務將會完全免費。

paragraphs.en: To support these individuals, we offer our notary services completely free of charge if you are experiencing financial difficulties.
Sai Hon has extensive practical experience in finance, business, management, and law, complemented by a broad academic background across various fields.
paragraphs.zh: 我在金融、商業、管理及法律方面都有相當的實戰經驗，並且在學術上也廣泛涉獵不同領域。

paragraphs.en: In his personal life, Sai Hon enjoys hiking, music, food, painting, and modern literature. However, as a notary public, he is unable to provide legal or immigration consultancy services.
paragraphs.zh: 日常生活上，本人喜歡遠足，音樂，美食、繪畫，現代文學等。然而，作為一名公證人，很抱歉本人是無法提供任何法律或移民顧問方面的意見的。

items: University of Missouri – Finance & Financial Management

intro.en: At Notary Public Mall, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy outlines the personal information we collect and how it is used. By using our website, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.
intro.zh: 在 Notary Public Mall，我們非常重視您的私隱。本私隱政策說明我們收集哪些個人資料，以及這些資料如何被使用。使用本網站，即表示您同意本政策所載條款。

text.en: As with most websites, our servers automatically collect basic information about visitors. This includes, but is not limited to, IP addresses, browser type, timestamps, and referring pages. This data does not identify specific visitors but is collected for routine administrative purposes and to help us understand how visitors use our site. This information allows us to improve the functionality of our website and provide more useful content.
text.zh: 與大多數網站一樣，我們的伺服器會自動收集訪客的基本資料，包括但不限於 IP 位址、瀏覽器類型、時間戳記及來源頁面。這些資料不會識別個別訪客，僅用於日常行政用途，並協助我們了解訪客如何使用本網站，從而改善網站功能並提供更有用的內容。

text.en: In some cases, our website uses cookies to store information about your preferences and browsing history. This helps us enhance your user experience by providing customized content or remembering your preferences. Third-party advertisers and partners may also use cookies, web beacons, or other tracking technologies to collect data on your visits to our site for the purpose of delivering personalized advertisements or other relevant content. These third parties operate under their own privacy policies, and we encourage you to review them for further details.
text.zh: 在某些情況下，本網站會使用 cookies 儲存您的偏好及瀏覽紀錄，以便提供個人化內容或記住您的設定，提升使用體驗。第三方廣告商及合作夥伴亦可能使用 cookies、網頁信標或其他追蹤技術，收集您造訪本網站的資料，用以投放個人化廣告或其他相關內容。這些第三方按其自身的私隱政策運作，建議您自行參閱詳情。

text.en: You have the ability to manage and control the use of cookies through your browser settings. If you have privacy concerns, you can disable cookies entirely, but this may affect your ability to use certain features of some websites. The recommended approach is to disable cookies for individual sites rather than all sites. Please refer to your browser’s help documentation for instructions on how to block cookies and other tracking mechanisms.
text.zh: 您可以透過瀏覽器設定管理及控制 cookies 的使用。如對私隱有所顧慮，可以完全停用 cookies，但這可能影響您使用部分網站的某些功能。建議只針對個別網站停用 cookies，而非全面停用。有關如何封鎖 cookies 及其他追蹤機制，請參閱您的瀏覽器說明文件。

title.zh: 有關 Google 廣告的特別說明

text.en: We may use Google’s advertising services, which may involve the use of cookies to display relevant ads based on your visits to our site and other sites. These cookies are used by Google to serve ads to you, based on your browsing activity. You can opt out of Google’s cookie usage by visiting the Google ad and content network privacy policy.
text.zh: 我們可能使用 Google 的廣告服務，其中可能涉及使用 cookies，根據您瀏覽本網站及其他網站的紀錄顯示相關廣告。Google 會根據您的瀏覽活動，利用這些 cookies 向您投放廣告。您可前往 Google 廣告及內容網絡私隱政策頁面，選擇停用 Google 的 cookies。

title.en: About Google Advertising: The DoubleClick DART Cookie
title.zh: 關於 Google 廣告：DoubleClick DART Cookie

text.en: Google’s DoubleClick DART cookie is used to serve ads on websites that display Google AdSense ads. When you visit these sites and interact with the ads, a cookie may be placed on your browser. This helps Google and its partners deliver more targeted advertisements. If you prefer to opt out of the DART cookie, you can visit the Google ad and content network privacy policy.
text.zh: Google 的 DoubleClick DART cookie 用於顯示 Google AdSense 廣告的網站。當您瀏覽這些網站並與廣告互動時，瀏覽器可能會被放置一個 cookie，協助 Google 及其合作夥伴投放更精準的廣告。如您希望停用 DART cookie，可前往 Google 廣告及內容網絡私隱政策頁面。

text.en: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be reflected on this page, and we encourage you to check back periodically to stay informed about how we are protecting your personal information.
text.zh: 我們保留隨時更新或修改本私隱政策的權利。任何更改都會在本頁反映，建議您定期查閱，以了解我們如何保護您的個人資料。

outro.en: If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please contact us.
outro.zh: 如對本私隱政策有任何疑問或意見，請與我們聯絡。
